content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments represent a shift towards decentralized finance, allowing creators to accept cryptocurrency for their digital products without the overhead of traditional payment processors. Unlike platforms like Gumroad, which charge up to 10% per sale, Solana transactions through NOWPayments incur only a 0.5% fee. This difference can dramatically impact profitability, especially for creators selling high volumes of digital goods. In fact, selling 100 products at $97 each could save you $921 in fees compared to Gumroad. This not only enhances your margins but also allows for greater control over your earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of Solana payments integrates various components that work seamlessly to provide a robust infrastructure for digital transactions. At the core, you have NOWPayments, which handles automatic crypto payment verification. Transactions are processed on the Solana blockchain, known for its high throughput and low fees. Creators can use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, while file delivery can be managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This setup ensures that creators maintain total ownership of their data and products, creating a self-sustaining ecosystem that operates independently of traditional platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or impractical. If you're an ebook author in Nigeria, a course instructor in Kenya, or a template designer in Venezuela, this solution empowers you to sell directly to your audience without relying on intermediaries. The architecture is built for those who want to take control of their digital commerce, providing a reliable means to monetize their skills and creations without the risk of payment rejections or platform lockouts.
Save significantly on transaction fees with NOWPayments versus traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To successfully deploy Solana payments for your digital products, you need a few key components. First, a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serves as the foundation for your online store. Second, a backend logic provider such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manages payment processing and product delivery. Third, NOWPayments facilitates seamless crypto transactions while providing support for over 300 cryptocurrencies. Together, these elements create a powerful stack that is not dependent on any single platform, ensuring your business remains agile and resilient.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying your digital commerce stack using Solana payments, follow these steps. First, select a hosting provider like GitHub Pages for your store. Next, integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions and configure your product delivery using either Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage orders and automate delivery. Finally, ensure that you optimize your store for the best user experience and start marketing your digital products to your audience. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the blueprints and templates you need to launch efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments in conjunction with a decentralized hosting solution. This method allows you to accept payments directly in crypto, eliminating the need for traditional payment platforms. By leveraging Solana, you can benefit from lower transaction fees and complete ownership of your sales data.
Maintain complete ownership of your digital products and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're searching for ways to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides everything you need to set up a sovereign digital commerce stack using crypto payments, ensuring you bypass conventional payment barriers.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

Yes, by deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack with Cloudflare and NOWPayments, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your customers without relying on Gumroad or Payhip.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for digital products?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a variety of digital currencies for your sales, including popular options like Bitcoin and USDT.
How can I ensure my customers get their products immediately?

By using automated delivery systems like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 integrated with backend logic, you can ensure that customers receive their digital products instantly after payment confirmation.
